rows.jp: 「ふう」
rows.en: “Whew.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Whew."

rows.jp: テーブルの上に、メモが置かれていた。
rows.en: A note lay on the table.

ghs.en: On the table was laid a memo.

rows.jp: 『夕食あるかも』
rows.en: “Dinner, maybe.”

ghs.en: 『There's dinner perhaps』
ghs.assessment: The English memo retains Japanese corner brackets rather than the edition's English quotation treatment.
ghs.remedy: Use the established English styling for a written note.

rows.jp: 「わーい、行く行くー」
rows.en: “Yay! I’m coming, I’m coming!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Weeee, I'm coming I'm comiiing!"

rows.jp: 自分で用意しないですんだ。
rows.en: That saved me from having to fix dinner myself.

ghs.en: I don't need to make it myself then.

rows.jp: 三分で着替えると、いそいそと彼女の家に向かうのだった。
rows.en: I changed in three minutes flat and practically skipped over to her place.

ghs.en: I changed my clothes in three minutes then cheerfully headed towards her house.

rows.jp: 夕食は、おいしゅうございました。
rows.en: Dinner was simply divine.

ghs.en: 'Twas a most pleasingly delicious dinner.

rows.jp: 蝋燭(ろうそく)に火をつける。
rows.en: I lit a candle.

ghs.en: I ignite a candle.

rows.jp: 独特の輝きが、室内を照らす。
rows.en: Its singular glow filled the room.

ghs.en: A very peculiar radiance illuminates the room.

rows.jp: 蝋燭が好きだった。
rows.en: I loved candles.

ghs.en: I loved candles.

rows.jp: 生の火に、強く惹かれた。
rows.en: Something about an open flame drew me in.

ghs.en: Their raw flame captivated me so strongly.

rows.jp: こうしてぼんやりと揺らめく炎を見ていると、心が囚われて、いつまでもいつまでもまどろんでいることができた。
rows.en: I could lose myself in that dim, wavering flame and drift there half-asleep forever and ever.

ghs.en: When I looked at the flickering flame swaying so absentmindedly, my heart was enraptured and I could just doze off endlessly, endlessly.

rows.jp: 以前、それで前髪を焦がしたこともある。
rows.en: I had even singed my bangs that way once before.

ghs.en: Once, I even singed my bangs in it because of that.

rows.jp: ぶっちゃけ三分前のことだ。
rows.en: By “before,” I mean three minutes ago.

ghs.en: OK, that was like three minutes ago.

rows.jp: 「……焦げた……ちくせう」
rows.en: “...Singed them... dagnabbit.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...singed... dammit."

rows.jp: 泣きそう。
rows.en: I was going to cry.

ghs.en: It's to cry.
ghs.assessment: 泣きそう is the first-person reaction 'I could cry.' 'It's to cry' is ungrammatical and removes the experiencer.

rows.jp: とにかく日記だ。
rows.en: Anyway. The diary.

ghs.en: Anyway, to the diary.

rows.jp: 分厚い日記帳を開く。
rows.en: I opened the thick journal.

ghs.en: I open the thick diary book.

rows.jp: 人生の記録は、大切だよな。
rows.en: A record of your life mattered, after all.

ghs.en: The records of life are really precious.

rows.jp: 今日は学校に行ったのに、授業をさぼった。%N冬子がやけにつんけんしていた。きっと生理だ。%Nけど生理だからって八つ当たりは良くない。
rows.en: Today I went to school, then skipped class.%NTouko was unusually prickly. She must be on her period.%NBeing on her period is no excuse for taking it out on me, though.

ghs.en:
Today I went to school, but cut class.
Touko was extremely crabby and mean.
Must be that time of the month.
But it's not nice that she gets eight kinds of angry because of biology.

rows.jp: 仕返しにこの日記上でひどいことをしてやる。
rows.en: To get even, I shall subject her to unspeakable acts upon these very pages.

ghs.en: As revenge, I'll do mean things to her in this diary.

rows.jp: いや、やめてっ
rows.en: ‘No—stop!’

ghs.en: Touko: "No! Stop!"

rows.jp: へへ、嫌がっていても体は正直（略）
rows.en: ‘Heh. You can protest all you want, but your body doesn’t lie—[rest omitted]’

ghs.en:
Me: "Heh heh, no says your voice, but your body
here has evidence (snip)"

rows.jp: あっ、そんなの、いや、やめてやめてっ
rows.en: ‘Ah! Not that! No, stop, stop!’

ghs.en: Touko: "Ahh, but that, no, stopit! Stopit!"

rows.jp: 駄目だ、もう男がここまで来たら引っ込みがつかないよ！　俺の自慢のライフルでおまえというターゲットにロックオンするしかないんだよ！
rows.en: ‘Too late! Once a man’s come this far, he can’t pull out! All I can do is lock my mighty rifle onto its one and only target—you!’

ghs.en:
Me: "Not happening, when a man has come this far
there is no retreat! I can do nothing but
acquire lock on the target that you are with
the rifle of my pride!"

rows.jp: いやぁーっ、体は、体はいやぁーっ！！
rows.en: ‘Nooo! Not my body! Anything but my body!’

ghs.en:
Touko: "NOOOO!!! My body, my body
you caaaaan't!!!"

rows.jp: すぐに自分から欲しがるようになるぜぇ
rows.en: ‘Soon you’ll be begging me for it.’

ghs.en: Me: "Soon you'll come to covet this yourself!"

rows.jp: いや、お慈悲！！
rows.en: ‘Mercy!’

ghs.en: Touko: "NOOO! Have mercy!!!"

rows.jp: 聞く耳持つか、どりゃーっ！！
rows.en: ‘Like hell I’ll listen! Hyaaah!’

ghs.en:
Me: "Do I look like I have ears that know how to
hear? Hyaaaa!!!"

rows.jp: ……けだものーっ！！
rows.en: ‘...You beast!’

ghs.en: Touko: "...animaaal!!!"

rows.jp: ここで赤い薔薇をさした花瓶のアップ。やがて花は根本で折れ、静かに落ちる。
rows.en: CLOSE-UP: A vase holding a red rose. The flower breaks at the stem and falls silently.

ghs.en: Close-up of a vase containing a red rose here. Soon afterwards, cut the flower at its base, that it falls to the ground in silence.
ghs.assessment: The flower itself eventually breaks at the base and falls quietly. The English turns this into an instruction for someone to cut it, inventing an agent and changing the action.
ghs.remedy: Say that the flower breaks at the base and quietly falls.

highlights.text: cut the flower at its base

rows.jp: 画面が滲んでいき、ホワイトアウト。【完】
rows.en: The screen blurs, fading to white. [THE END]

ghs.en:
The screen blurs, whiteout.
【FIN】

rows.jp: 廊下を歩いていると、美希が掃除をしていた。
rows.en: While walking down the hall, I saw Miki cleaning.

ghs.en: I was walking down the corridor to find Miki cleaning.

rows.jp: 俺の指先は美希の尻に触れそうになったが、かすめただけで実体をとらえることはできなかった。
rows.en: My fingertips grazed Miki’s ass, but that was all. I never got a proper feel.

ghs.en:
The tips of my fingers fired towards Miki's ass with the speed of lightning, but merely grazed and couldn't seize the substance.
But Miki had been slow up until now, enough that I could touch her as much I liked.
This is a most alarming problem, Headmaster!

variantDisplay.ghsJapanese:
俺の指先は電光石火で美希の尻を狙ったが、かすめただけで実体をとらえることはできなかった。
美希はとろくて今まで触り放題だったのに。
これはゆゆしき問題ですぞ、校長！

rows.jp: 美希はとろくて今まで触り放題だったのに。
rows.en: Miki used to be so slow I could grope her whenever I pleased.

rows.jp: これはゆゆしき問題ですぞ、校長！
rows.en: This is a grave matter, Principal!

rows.jp: だが弟子が腕をあげたことは、素直に嬉しい。師である俺が抜かれる日は近い。
rows.en: Still, I was genuinely pleased to see how much my pupil had improved. The day she surpassed her master was close at hand.

ghs.en: The day when she surpasses I, her mentor, grows near.
ghs.assessment: The English omits the statement that he is honestly pleased by his pupil's improvement; 'surpasses I' is also ungrammatical.
ghs.remedy: Still, I was genuinely glad my pupil had improved. The day she surpassed her teacher was not far off.

highlights.text: The day when she surpasses I, her mentor, grows near.

rows.jp: 久しぶりに部活に行って、みみ先輩にぱふぱふをした。%Nこの日、俺は一つの到達点に辿り着いた。%N感動、大。
rows.en: Went to the club for the first time in ages and had a Puff-Puff with Mimi.%NOn this day, I reached a new milestone.%NEmotion: immense.

ghs.en: I am moved to tears, lots.
ghs.assessment: The English preserves only the final exclamation and omits the two preceding statements in the same source row.
ghs.remedy: After a long absence, I went to the club and got a faceful of Mimi's breasts. That day, I reached a new summit. Deeply moving.

highlights.text: I am moved to tears, lots.

rows.jp: 他にもいろいろとあったが、全体的に良い日だった。
rows.en: Other things happened too, but all in all, it was a good day.

ghs.en: And lots of other stuff happened, so overall it was a good day.
